systems.system: Education Management Information System (EMIS) / annual Statistical Yearbooks
systems.country_label: EMIS; Statistical Yearbooks (two national censuses a year)
systems.platform: paper forms completed by hand, some schools reporting to the school district office (CISCO) by phone; digital tools for collection at school level deployed repeatedly since 2016 without lasting
systems.tiers: schools return to CISCO; yearbook takes about six months to produce; the project proposes to digitise it and give principals tablets or smartphones for real-time reporting
to be scaled up under subcomponent 3.1
to be used for a teacher redeployment and compensation strategy
2.8 per cent of public schools have a laptop or tablet, 2.0 per cent an internet connection and 0.4 per cent of schools grid electricity

note: The EMIS described is the twice-yearly school census, filled in by hand; the document describes no per-learner record entered by schools, and the proposed tablets are for reporting by principals, so every system named is of a noted class.
